subject: English
question_text: Do you have any root other than the place where you are living now? If yes, where is it and who live there? If not, why not? (তুমি কি এখন যেখানে থাকো তার বাইরে আর কোনো শেকড় আছে? যদি থাকে, তবে কোথায় এবং সেখানে কে থাকে? যদি না থাকে, তবে কেন না?)
guide_solution: Yes, I have my root in a small town called Magura. My grandparents, uncles, aunts, and cousins live there. (হ্যাঁ, আমার শেকড় একটি ছোট শহর মাগুরায়। সেখানে আমার দাদা-দাদি, চাচা-চাচি ও কাজিনরা থাকেন।)

subject: English
question_text: Do you feel any attraction for your roots? (তুমি কি তোমার শেকড়ের প্রতি কোনো আকষর্ণ অনুভব করো?)

subject: English
question_text: How do you nourish your roots? (তুমি কীভাবে তোমার শেকড়কে লালন করো?)

subject: English
question_text: What, according to you, are the reasons why people become rootless? (তোমার মতে, মানুষ শেকড়হীন হয়ে যায় কেন?)
guide_solution: People become rootless when they cut off ties with their families, culture, traditions, and birthplace. Migration to foreign countries without keeping bonds with their roots is another reason. (মানুষ তখন শেকড়হীন হয়ে পড়ে যখন তারা পরিবার, সংস্কৃতি, ঐতিহ্য এবং জন্মভূমির সাথে সম্পকর্ ছিন্ন করে। বিদেশে গিয়ে শেকড়ের সঙ্গে সম্পকর্ না রাখাও একটি কারণ।) F. subject: English
question_text: Read some more information on Madhusudan. Make questions for those statements.
stimulus: a. Who introduced amitrakshar chhanda (blank verse) in Bangla literature?
guide_solution: He introduced amitrakshar chhanda (blank verse) in Bangla literature. b. Where did Madhusudan pass most of his European days? Ans. Madhusudan passed most of his European days in Versailles, France. c. What were Madhusudan’s days in Europe full of? Ans. His days in Europe were full of hardship. d. Why was life unbearable to Madhusudan in Europe? Ans. It was unbearable to him as he had to suffer extreme poverty. e. Who helped Madhusudan to pay off his debts and return to India? Ans. It was Iswar Chandra Vidyasagar who helped him to pay off his debts and return to India. f. Whom did Madhusudan marry while living in Madras? Ans. Madhusudan married twice. While living in Madras, he married Rebecca Mactavys of English descent. g. Whom did Madhusudan marry later? Ans. Later he married Henrietta Sophia White, who was also ethnic English. h. How long did Madhusudan’s second marriage last? Ans. His second marriage lasted until the end of his life. i. What were the names of Madhusudan and Sophia’s children? Ans. Madhusudan and Sophia had a son Napoleon and daughter Sharmistha. j. When and where did Madhusudan die? Ans. Madhusudan died in Calcutta General Hospital on 27 June 1873, three days after the death of Henrietta.
